question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"permit."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Permit"** means to allow or give permission. (किसी बात की अनुमति देना या कोई बात होने देना)
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank, as the other options do not fit the context of the sentence.
 
 
• **Example**: *The school principal will **permit**__ students to attend the field trip if they have their parent's permission slip signed.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
 
• Correct passage:

If you __surround__ yourself with the good and righteous, they can only __raise__ you up. If you __encircle__ yourself with the others, they will __drag__ you down into the doldrums of mediocrity, and they will keep you there, but only as long as you __**permit**__ it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2, "disregard"**, means to ignore or pay no attention to. (किसी की उपेक्षा करना, किसी बात पर ध्यान न देना; किसी बात को महत्वहीन या उपेक्षणीय समझना)
 
• **Option 3, "overlook"**, means to fail to notice or consider something. (किसी वस्‍तु को देखने या उस पर ध्यान देने से चूक जाना, अनदेखी कर जाना)
 
• **Option 4, "forget"**, means to fail to remember something. (याद न रहना, भूल जाना)
